principled endorsement this election season. So I have the honor of being with Vermin Supreme
on the eve of the election November 5th year in Manchester, New Hampshire.
Its election eve and soon the great ballot box will come down from the sky and come
to the most beautiful polling station and if we are there it will bring democracy to all
the good citizens. And with democracy one of the things that we might be expecting if
Vermin Supreme was to be a successful candidate is the mandatory tooth brushing law.
Yes sir. With the mandatory tooth brushing law the American Dental Association has in
the past endorsed a thrice daily tooth brushing recommendation. So more recently it's
been reduced to twice daily. Under Vermin Supreme's presidency what will exactly be the
enforcement level of brushing will it be daily twice thrice?
Well once again you at once should not be fooled by the misinformation that is being
perpetuated by false teeth profits. This mandatory tooth brushing law is not about the secret
dental commandos knock you down your door at 3 a.m. to make sure you have brought. It is
not about the secret dental police. It is not about the dental reeducation centers. It
is not about the preventive dental, the maintenance, the chancin facilities. Nor is it about the
computer dental chip implants in your teeth to keep track of you and your children for
your safety. It is not about the government issue toothpaste containing an addictive
yet harmless substance. Nor is it even about the DNA gene splicing to create a race of
winged monkeys to act as tooth fairy enforcers. What this mandatory tooth brushing law is
really about is strong teeth for a strong America. Thank you. I'm Vermin Supreme.
Well there needs for a new three-letter acronym agency to enforce the tooth brushing.
I believe yes and that might be the FDI, the federal dental inspectors.
Do you believe that water picks are effective or do they just push the plaque into the teeth
further? I haven't read all the scientific studies so I don't want to commit one way
in another. I don't want to be perceived as a flip flopper and once again I don't want
to give any commercial endorsements at this time. Once again of course, charter control
now will negate the need for crowd control later and aren't water picks just sort of like
big water cannons, spraying away protesters from the gum line of the street. I think they
are. So some of your naysayers have been saying that I get it naysayers.
Targeting the fact that brushing the teeth does not always do much to prevent bad breath
from forming because sometimes the plaque is on the tongue. That's true.
Well your presidency addressed that issue at all. It certainly shall. I believe that mouth
rinses will be all the rage. I believe many beverages will have breath fresh and in capability.
Of course a lot of people want to know about the flossing issue is America ready for a
flossing amendment. I don't believe that they are. I believe that it would certainly pass
the house but I don't see it pass in the Senate anytime soon. So it will have to be incremental.
And one final question. Press call gate for third party pays.

Interview with presidential candidate Vermin Supreme of the Free Pony Party. Vermin gives sparse details about the truth behind his dental program and proposed mandatory teeth-brushing laws. With Mitt Romney and Kid Rock in Manchester, New Hampshire Nov 5 2012
